turns.text: You know, what did I miss?
turns.zh: 你知道，我到底漏掉了什么？

turns.text: You know, what more can I feed into you to make sure that you're safe and sound and secure?
turns.zh: 你知道，我还能多给你什么，才能确保你平平安安、稳稳当当的？

turns.text: But the truth of the matter is that we we don't control that.
turns.zh: 但事实是，这个我们控制不了。

turns.text: And as a parent, that's a hard thing to come to grips with as your child is is your child grows up and is out there in that big, bad world, is that you can prepare and love them all, all that you can, and you still don't have control.
turns.zh: 而作为父母，随着孩子长大、走进那个又大又险的世界，你很难接受的一点是：你可以尽力去准备、去爱他们，但你还是控制不了。

turns.text: There are no guarantees that their life is going to work out and something bad may happen.
turns.zh: 没人能保证他们的人生会一帆风顺，坏事也可能发生。

turns.text: That is the hardest thing about parenting, is living with that truth.
turns.zh: 养孩子最难的地方，就是得带着这个事实活下去。

turns.text: But the alternative is to stop them from growing.
turns.zh: 但另一个选择就是阻止他们成长。

turns.text: And that, in my view, would be the sad outcome: if my kids were sitting safe in my basement or in their rooms at home with me feeling comforted in the fact that I knew what they were doing and where they were, but not owning their own lives.
turns.zh: 而在我看来，那才是可悲的结果：如果我的孩子就安全地待在我家地下室或者他们自己的房间里，跟我在一起，因为我知道他们在做什么、在哪里而感到安心，但他们却没有掌控自己的人生。
